summary: Elbit Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing a roughly $260 million contract award to supply PULS rocket artillery systems and munitions to a European NATO member country, performed over five years. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership terms are stated; it is an ordinary defense supply contract win, not a special situation. Watch execution and backlog conversion rather than any deal-arbitrage angle.
